brief:
The Guardian has produced a documentary featuring testimony from 24 Israeli military insiders describing secret systems used in mass killings of Gaza civilians. The film includes detailed accounts from those directly involved in surveillance and remote killing operations during the war in Gaza.

The documentary represents one of the most extensive collections of firsthand accounts from Israeli military personnel willing to discuss the technical and operational methods employed. Participants in the project include military professionals with direct experience in the surveillance and targeting infrastructure that the film investigates. The revelations focus on the mechanics and decision-making processes behind remote killings conducted during the conflict.
